title: Production Sage.js browser execution environment
objective: Ship a staged static sagejs.org execution application with local persistent worksheets, bounded interruptible browser execution, rich graphics, offline caching, isolated-origin headers, accessibility, security documentation, and focused tests

oracles: Existing packages/flint-wasm SageSession public browser API

handoff.summary: Implemented and integrated the production static Sage.js browser workspace: accessible editor execution controls, streamed bounded output, Plotly rendering, interrupt/reset/recovery, local worksheets and source-only sharing, source/SagePack interchange, public capability filtering, content-addressed authenticated runtime staging, Cloudflare isolation headers, offline cache upgrade/rollback, public privacy/limits documentation, and 17 focused tests.
risks: End-to-end offline browser execution requires the final pinned packages/flint-wasm reactor artifact and generated architecture capability report, which are owned by dependency lanes.
The shared browser kernel still requires integration-owned protocol-global isolation and an explicit in-memory filesystem quota before the public release gate.
next_steps: After all Wasm lanes integrate, run node website/live/test/browser-offline.mjs against the final authenticated production artifact.
Run pnpm docs:check and pnpm test:tutorial once in the final integration workspace; the coordinator stopped this lane's contended broad rebuild to prioritize the pinned FLINT reactor.
Deploy website/live/dist to the dedicated non-credentialed app.sagejs.org origin without adding cookies, privileged APIs, CDNs, or remote fonts.
